question: What has Accenture reported most recently, and what is its outlook for fiscal 2027?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect the agent to identify the 2026-10-01 release (fiscal year ended 2026-08-31): Q4 revenue USD 18.68B (+6% USD, +7% local currency) above the guided USD 17.75B-18.40B; FY2026 revenue about USD 74.2B; FY2027 outlook revenue growth 3%-6% in local currency and GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later runs may have newer developments. Must cite dated sources and not present superseded (June 2026) figures as current.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the most recent Accenture development is its fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results released October 1, 2026 (year ended August 31, 2026): Q4 revenues USD 18.68 billion (+6% in USD, +7% in local currency), above the guided USD 17.75-18.40 billion; Q4 new bookings USD 22.17 billion; full-year revenues USD 74.2 billion (+6% USD, +5% local currency) and GAAP diluted EPS USD 13.56 (adjusted USD 13.97). Fiscal 2027 outlook: revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency, operating margin 15.9%-16.1%, GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81, free cash flow USD 11.0-11.8 billion and at least USD 9.5 billion of capital return; Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to USD 18.95-19.60 billion. [T15-E1, T15-E2]

output.answer:
Accenture most recently reported its **fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results** (for the quarter ended August 31, 2026). The company beat expectations, sending its stock up more than 18%.

**Q4 FY2026 highlights:**
- **Revenue:** $18.68 billion (up 6% year over year; up 7% in local currency), beating estimates of ~$18.03 billion
- **Diluted EPS:** $3.29 (up 8-9% YoY), ahead of the $3.18 consensus
- **New bookings:** $22.2 billion, with a book-to-bill ratio of 1.2
- **Free cash flow:** ~$2.8–$2.9 billion in the quarter

**Full FY2026 highlights:**
- **Revenue:** $74.18 billion (up 6% in USD; up 5% in local currency)
- **Adjusted EPS:** $13.97 (up 8% YoY)
- **Shareholder returns:** Record $11.5 billion returned over the year

---

**Outlook for fiscal 2027:**
- **Revenue growth:** **3% to 6%** in local currency (including an estimated **2% to 2.5%** contribution from acquisitions)
- **GAAP diluted EPS:** **$14.39 to $14.81**
- **Adjusted operating margin:** **15.9% to 16.1%**
- **Q1 FY2027 revenue guidance:** $18.95 billion to $19.60 billion (2% to 6% local-currency growth)

Management noted that demand remains broad-based across markets and services, with AI work continuing to expand, though hiring will slow compared to fiscal 2026. The company also flagged that roughly $3 billion in Cyber OT acquisition revenue shifted into Q1 FY2027 due to regulatory timing.

**Sources:**
- [Yahoo Finance – Accenture Q4 2026 earnings beat sends stock up 22%](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-q4-2026-earnings-beat-172435987.html)
- [Yahoo Finance – Accenture shares soar on fourth-quarter estimates, fiscal 2027 growth forecasts](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-shares-soar-fourth-quarter-151100410.html)
- [Yahoo Finance – What Accenture (ACN) Said on Its Q4 Earnings Call](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/accenture-acn-said-q4-earnings-140357109.html)
